book.name: SAN LUCAS
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN LUCAS

content: Yet yilaxto Comam Jesús sata naj Pilato
Sunil ebnaj ah wejnahi, yinito ebnaj Comam Jesús sata naj Pilato.

Yoc ebnaj akꞌocꞌule yin̈ Comam tet naj Pilato hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Machalo huneꞌ naj tiꞌ juan̈, sunil anma chisomchato isnabal yu naj, cat iscachni naj anma ta mach chakꞌ istohlabal tet naj César, naj jahaw ay bey Roma, cat yalnipaxo isba naj Cristohal, haꞌ chalilo jahawil, ẍi ebnaj.
Iskꞌamben naj Pilato tet Comam: —¿Tom yahawil anma Israel hawehi? ẍi naj. Istakꞌwi Comam: —Hoꞌ, yeli hacaꞌ hawalni tiꞌ, ẍi Comam.
Yuxinto yal naj Pilato tet ebnaj yahawil yeco yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote, yeb tet sunil anma cutxanico tuꞌ: —Haꞌ huneꞌ winaj tiꞌ, machi hunu mule chiꞌilchalo yin̈ wuhan, ẍi naj.
Ischilban ebnaj, yalni yin̈ caw ip: —Lan̈an issomchato isnabal sunil anma yu cuybanile chakꞌ naj. Ichiti naj iscuyni anma bey Galilea, tinan̈ xin hac tuꞌ chutepaxo naj bey Judea tiꞌ, ẍi ebnaj.
Yet yilaxto Comam Jesús sata naj Herodes
Hayet yaben naj Pilato huneꞌ tuꞌ, iskꞌamben naj ta ah Galilea Comam.
Hayet yaben naj ta ah Galilea Comam, yanito naj Comam yul iskꞌab naj Herodes, yuto naj Herodes tuꞌ ayco yahawilo bey Galilea. Cꞌuxan xin aycꞌo naj Herodes bey Jerusalén yet yuni huneꞌ tuꞌ.
Hayet yilni naj Herodes Comam, caw tzalacan̈ naj yuto payxa ichi yochen naj yilaꞌ Comam. Caw xin txꞌiꞌalxa bay chabe naj yin̈ Comam. Caw xin choche naj yilaꞌ iswatxꞌen Comam hunu cꞌaybalcꞌule.
Caw txꞌiꞌal tzet iskꞌambe naj tet Comam, yajaꞌ maẍticꞌa takꞌwi Comam tet naj.
Wal ebnaj iswiꞌehal yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote yeb ebnaj chicuyni anma yin̈ isley naj Moisés, caw ischilba ebnaj yoc akꞌocꞌule yin̈ Comam.

Naj Herodes yeb ebnaj issoldado tuꞌ oc ebnaj isbuchuꞌ Comam. Yanico ebnaj huneꞌ xilkꞌape yin̈ Comam hacaꞌ chaco ebnaj rey yun̈e yoc ebnaj tzebo yin̈ Comam. Lahwi tuꞌ xin, yanipaxto naj Herodes tuꞌ Comam yul iskꞌab naj Pilato hunelxa.
Yin̈ticꞌa huneꞌ tzꞌayical tuꞌ, naj Pilato yeb naj Herodes oc ebnaj amigohal, yaj wal yet yalan̈to caw ayleco ishowal ebnaj yin̈ hunun.
Yet iscawxelaxico camical yiban̈ Comam Jesús
Iscutxbanico naj Pilato ebnaj iswiꞌehal yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote, yeb ebnaj yahaw con̈ob, yebpaxo sunil anma yul con̈ob tuꞌ.

Yalni naj tet ebnaj: —Haꞌ huneꞌ naj maxeyiti wettiꞌan cheyala ta lan̈an issomchancan̈ naj isnabal sunil anma. Wal xin tesata mankꞌambehan tet naj, yajaꞌ caw machi hunu ismul naj chiꞌilchalo wuhan hacaꞌ cheyute heyalni tiꞌ.
Mawatojan naj yul iskꞌab naj Herodes, yajaꞌ mach ismul naj mailcha yu naj, yuxin mayapaxti naj Herodes tuꞌ naj hunelxa wetan. Wal xin, mach ismul naj chꞌakꞌni camoj.
Ton̈e xin chiwakꞌ hatelaxojan naj, cat inbejtzonan naj, ẍi naj Pilato tuꞌ,
yuto yin̈ hunun kꞌin̈ Pascua chibejtzolax hunun ebnaj presowom.
Yaj sunil anma cutxanico bey tuꞌ, ah yaw yin̈ caw ip: —¡Ilo huneꞌ naj tiꞌ yin̈ cosatan̈, cat hebejtzon naj Barrabás! ẍixan̈e anma.
Yaj naj Barrabás tuꞌ, ayco naj preso yu huneꞌ howal yicheco naj yul con̈ob tuꞌ, yebpaxo potxꞌom anma naj.
Wal naj Pilato, caw yoche naj isbejtzoꞌ Comam Jesús, yuxinto tzotelilti naj xol anma hunelxa.
Yajaꞌ anma tuꞌ, caw ecꞌbalto ah yaw, yalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¡Camojab naj yin̈ culus! ¡Camojab naj yin̈ culus! ẍixan̈e anma tuꞌ.

Yalni naj Pilato yin̈ yoxel tet ebnaj: —¿Tzet yu? ¿Tzet istxꞌojal iswatxꞌe naj heyalni? Mach hunu ismul naj chiꞌilchalo yin̈ wuhan chꞌakꞌni camoj. Wal xin ton̈e chinchejan hatelaxo naj, cat inbejtzonan naj, ẍi naj.
Ischilban ebnaj yel yaw yin̈ caw ip, iskꞌanni camo ebnaj Comam yin̈ teꞌ culus. Yu caw chꞌel yaw ebnaj yuxinto akꞌlax tzet choche ebnaj.
Yuxinto isyije naj Pilato tzet iskꞌan ebnaj.
Wal xin, haꞌ naj ayco preso yu howal yeb yu potxꞌwal, haꞌ naj isbejtzoto naj Pilato hacaꞌ yu iskꞌanni ebnaj. Yanico naj Pilato Comam yul iskꞌab ebnaj.
Yet yalaxcan̈ Comam Jesús yin̈ culus

Yet lan̈an yilaxto Comam Jesús bay chꞌalaxcan̈ yin̈ culus, istzabnayo ebnaj huneꞌ naj, Simón isbi. Lan̈an yocto naj yul con̈ob tuꞌ, haꞌ bey txꞌotxꞌ Cirene ay naj. Yalaxico isculus Comam yiban̈ naj, yoc tzujno naj yinta Comam.
Caw hantan̈e anma oc tzujno yinta Comam; xol anma tuꞌ ay huntekꞌan ebix caw chꞌokꞌ yu biscꞌulal yin̈ Comam.
Istꞌan̈xiti Comam yin̈ ebix, yalni Comam tet ebix: —Hex ix ah Jerusalén tiꞌ, mach chexokꞌ win̈an. Okꞌan̈we teyin̈ yeb yin̈ niẍtej heyunin.
Yuto chihul istzꞌayical bay chihallax hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Sakꞌal yet ebix ix maẍticꞌa yunin, yeb ebix maẍticꞌa unin chitxutxwi yin̈,” ẍi anma tuꞌ.
Yet huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ, chal anma hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Majaltam chititcꞌay witz tiꞌ jiban̈, cat comujicano yalan̈,” ẍi anma tuꞌ.
Ta hanintiꞌan, lahaninan hacaꞌ hunu teꞌ kꞌepta caw yax, yaj chꞌecꞌyaꞌ wanmahan yu anma, hajxamex hex tiꞌ, lahanex yeb teꞌ tajin teꞌ caw niman isyaꞌtajil cheyila, ẍi Comam.
Aypaxo cawan̈xa ebnaj caw xiwquilta ismul, ilaxto camo yin̈ culus yinta Comam.

Hayet yapni ebnaj bey huneꞌ txꞌotxꞌ chij Calavera, chalilo Isbajil Wiꞌe, yalaxcan̈ Comam yin̈ culus. Hac tuꞌ utelax cawan̈ ebnaj xiwquilta ismul tuꞌ, huneꞌ naj ah yin̈ iswatxꞌkꞌab Comam, hunxa naj yin̈ ismeckꞌab Comam.

Hayet aycan̈ Comam yin̈ culus tuꞌ, yalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Mamin, akꞌ nimancꞌulal yin̈ anma tiꞌ, yuto mach chinachalo yu ta txꞌoj tzet chiswatxꞌe, ẍi Comam. Yoc ebnaj soldado yilweno isba yin̈ mac chiinito xil iskꞌap Comam.

Sunil anma tuꞌ tꞌan̈anico yilni tzet chuhi; yoc ebnaj yahaw con̈ob buchwal yin̈ Comam, yalni ebnaj: —Ta haꞌ naj tiꞌ Cristo sicꞌbililo yu Comam Dios, iscolabayti isba naj, hacaꞌ yu iscolwa naj yin̈ anma, ẍi ebnaj.
Hacpax tuꞌ ebnaj soldado, oc ebnaj buchwal yin̈ Comam, yakꞌni ebnaj pahla vinagre yucꞌuꞌ Comam.
Yalni ebnaj: —Ta yeli yahaw anma Israel hawehi, colayti haba, ẍi ebnaj.
Yin̈ iswiꞌ isculus Comam tzꞌibn̈ebilico hayeb tzꞌib, chalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Haꞌ naj tiꞌ, yahawil anma Israel,” ẍicoj.
Xol ebnaj cawan̈ alaxcan̈ yin̈ culus yinta Comam, ay huneꞌ naj txꞌoj istzotel tet Comam, yalni naj tet Comam: —Ta hach tiꞌ Cristo hach, colayto haba, cat con̈hacolnipaxaytojan̈, ẍi naj.
Haxa huneꞌxa yetbi naj cachwa yin̈ hacaꞌ tiꞌ: ¿Tom mach chaxiw tet Comam Dios? ¿Tom mach chawila tato lahan jeco yin̈ isyaꞌtajil yeb yaꞌ?
Wal han̈on̈ tiꞌ, lan̈an yecꞌyaꞌ janma yu cotohlan istxꞌojal cowatxꞌe, wal yaꞌ tiꞌ, machi nino istxꞌojal iswatxꞌe yaꞌ, ẍi naj tet yetbi tuꞌ.
Yalni naj tet Comam: —Mam Jesús, chinhanabaꞌtijan yet chaẍhul cat hawoc yahawil, ẍi naj tet Comam.
Yalni Comam tet naj: —Yin̈ caw isyelal chiwalan tawet, haꞌticꞌa tinan̈ chaẍapno incꞌatan̈an bey huneꞌ ehobal chij Paraíso, ẍi Comam tet naj.
Yet iscam Comam Jesús
Yet chuman xin iskꞌejholilo yul yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ masanto yin̈ chꞌen oxeb yin̈ kꞌejbiyal issajbipaxiloj.
Istzilmopaxayo huneꞌ kꞌap kꞌap aycan̈ yul yatut Comam Dios, cab ayico kꞌap.
Yah yaw Comam yin̈ caw ip, yalni: —Mam, yul hakꞌab chiwacanicojan wanmatiꞌan, ẍi Comam.
Hayet yilni naj yahawil ebnaj soldado ah Roma huneꞌ tuꞌ, yoc naj yalno cꞌulla tzotiꞌ yin̈ Comam Dios, yalni naj: —Yin̈ caw yeli, huneꞌ winaj tiꞌ mach ismul, ẍi naj.
Sunil anma cutxanico bey tuꞌ, hayet yilni tzet yuhi, cawtoxan̈e chistin̈ anma istxam iscꞌul yu biscꞌulal yet ispaxto yatut.
Wal sunil anma yohta isba yeb Comam Jesús, yeb huntekꞌan ebix tit yinta Comam bey Galilea, nahat lin̈anti yilni tzet chuhi.
Yet ismujlax Comam Jesús
Ay huneꞌ naj José isbi, ay bey con̈ob Arimatea, yul ismajul Judea; naj tuꞌ, caw cꞌul iscꞌul naj, caw cꞌulpaxo isbeybal naj. Ayco naj xol ebnaj iswiꞌehal yin̈ lahtiꞌ yul con̈ob Israel.
Yajaꞌ mach yaco isba naj yin̈ istxꞌojal iswatxꞌe ebnaj yetbi tuꞌ yin̈ Comam Jesús, yuto chechma naj yoc Comam Dios Yahawiloj.
Isto naj José tuꞌ iskꞌanno isnimanil Comam tet naj Pilato.

Lahwi tuꞌ xin, isto naj yinoyti isnimanil Comam yin̈ teꞌ culus, ispichnico naj huneꞌ sábana caw cꞌul yin̈. Isto naj yanocto isnimanil Comam yul huneꞌ chꞌen chꞌen holbil yul, caw xin maẍto hunu camom chiꞌalaxicto yul chꞌen.
Haꞌ yin̈ huneꞌ tzꞌayical tuꞌ chiskꞌuy isba anma Israel yin̈ tzet chislo yin̈ tzꞌayic xewilal. Lan̈anxa xin isto tzꞌayic cat yichico tzꞌayic xewilal.
Haꞌ ebix ix tit yinta Comam bey Galilea, topaxo ebix mujwal yin̈ Comam, yilni ebix chꞌen chꞌen bay alaxicto Comam, yilnipaxo ebix tzet yucanicto isnimanil Comam.
Lahwi ispaxto ebix, iswatxꞌen ebix cab majan an̈ caw xukꞌ sam chꞌoc yin̈ isnimanil Comam. Lahwi tuꞌ xin yichico tzꞌayic xewilal, yuxin xew ebix hacaꞌticꞌa yalni isley naj Moisés.
